description.en: DSH plugins for reverse engineering, cracking and evidence-driven delivery, plus desktop automation, research, image generation and the ArtCraft document suite. Our own plugins ship as git sources; ds-bot comes from its npm release.
description.zh: DSH 插件市场：逆向破解技能、MCP 接线、破解工作台与证据报告，外加桌面操作、全网调研、本机生图与 ArtCraft 文档套件。自有插件用 git 源发布，DS Bot 取 npm 发布版。

description.en: Three-tier web research ported from ZCode: fast / wide / deep over reach_* MCP channels (Tavily, Exa, Jina, Parallel, TinyFish, Firecrawl, Valyu) with evidence IDs, counter-evidence and gap accounting.
description.zh: 从 ZCode 移植的三档全网调研：fast / wide / deep，走 reach_* MCP 渠道（Tavily、Exa、Jina、Parallel、TinyFish、Firecrawl、Valyu），自带证据 ID、反例与缺口说明。

description.en: macOS computer-use tools for DSH: cua_screenshot / cua_windows / cua_click / cua_type / cua_key / cua_scroll / cua_drag, backed by screencapture, cliclick, osascript and pyobjc.
description.zh: macOS 桌面操作工具：cua_* 系列（截屏、窗口枚举、点击、移动、输入、按键、滚动、拖拽），后端只用 screencapture + cliclick + osascript + pyobjc。

description.en: Seven-stage cracking workbench: intake, license patch, keygen, APK, unpacking and evidence report.
description.zh: 七阶段破解工作台：接单建档、授权补丁、注册机、APK、脱壳与证据报告。

title.zh: DS Bot · 多 Bot 工作台

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a team of long-lived Bots: a Main Bot, Bot-to-Bot messages, group chats, a folder and memory per Bot, private Bots, scheduled work and Word/PowerPoint/Excel documents. Ships a desktop app too.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成一队长期在线的 Bot：主 Bot、Bot 之间互发消息、群聊、每个 Bot 独立文件夹与记忆、私有 Bot、定时任务，以及 Word/PowerPoint/Excel 文档读写；另带独立桌面端。

description.en: CAD drafting: entities, layers, dimensions and dxf/dwg/svg conversion, driven headlessly from a DSH plugin over the app's own CLI and MCP server.
description.zh: CAD 绘图：实体、图层、尺寸标注与 dxf/dwg/svg 转换（cadcraft-cli），由 DSH 插件无头驱动：命令目录、执行、检查、转换与自带 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Presentations: slides, layouts, notes and pptx read/write, driven headlessly from a DSH plugin over the app's own CLI and MCP server.
description.zh: 演示文稿：幻灯片、版式、备注与 pptx 读写（deckcraft-cli），由 DSH 插件无头驱动：命令目录、执行、检查、转换与自带 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Page layout: artboards, masters, text/image flow and print export, driven headlessly from a DSH plugin over the app's own CLI and MCP server.
description.zh: 页面排版：画板、母版、图文混排与印刷导出（designcraft-cli），由 DSH 插件无头驱动：命令目录、执行、检查、转换与自带 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Motion graphics: comps, keyframes, effects and render, driven headlessly from a DSH plugin over the app's own CLI and MCP server.
description.zh: 动效合成：合成、关键帧、特效与渲染（effectcraft-cli），由 DSH 插件无头驱动：命令目录、执行、检查、转换与自带 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Non-linear editing: timeline, transitions, multicam and transcode, driven headlessly from a DSH plugin over the app's own CLI and MCP server.
description.zh: 非线性剪辑：时间线、转场、多机位与转码（filmcraft-cli），由 DSH 插件无头驱动：命令目录、执行、检查、转换与自带 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Spreadsheets: cells, formulas, charts and xlsx read/write, driven headlessly from a DSH plugin over the app's own CLI and MCP server.
description.zh: 电子表格：单元格、公式、图表与 xlsx 读写（gridcraft-cli），由 DSH 插件无头驱动：命令目录、执行、检查、转换与自带 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Photo library and RAW development: catalog, ratings, develop, driven headlessly from a DSH plugin over the app's own CLI and MCP server.
description.zh: 照片库与 RAW 显影：目录、评级、显影参数（lightcraft-cli），由 DSH 插件无头驱动：命令目录、执行、检查、转换与自带 MCP 服务器。

description.en: PDF reading, editing, text extraction and full-page rendering, driven headlessly from a DSH plugin over the app's own CLI and MCP server.
description.zh: PDF 读取、编辑、抽取与整页渲染（pdfcraft-cli），由 DSH 插件无头驱动：命令目录、执行、检查、转换与自带 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Raster editing: layers, selections, filters and export, driven headlessly from a DSH plugin over the app's own CLI and MCP server.
description.zh: 位图编辑：图层、选区、滤镜与导出（photocraft-cli），由 DSH 插件无头驱动：命令目录、执行、检查、转换与自带 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Digital audio workstation: tracks, effects, mixdown and export, driven headlessly from a DSH plugin over the app's own CLI and MCP server.
description.zh: 音频工作站：音轨、效果、混音与导出（soundcraft-cli），由 DSH 插件无头驱动：命令目录、执行、检查、转换与自带 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Vector art: paths, beziers, strokes and SVG/PDF export, driven headlessly from a DSH plugin over the app's own CLI and MCP server.
description.zh: 矢量绘图：路径、贝塞尔、描边与 SVG/PDF 导出（vectorcraft-cli），由 DSH 插件无头驱动：命令目录、执行、检查、转换与自带 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Word processing: paragraphs, styles, TOC and docx read/write, driven headlessly from a DSH plugin over the app's own CLI and MCP server.
description.zh: 文字处理：段落、样式、目录与 docx 读写（wordcraft-cli），由 DSH 插件无头驱动：命令目录、执行、检查、转换与自带 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Suggest the next user message as composer ghost text after an assistant turn; Tab accepts into the draft, Escape dismisses. Includes Predictions settings and conflict detection.
description.zh: 助手回复后在空输入框显示下一句预测；Tab 接受到草稿、Esc 关闭，含 Predictions 设置与同类插件冲突检测。

description.en: Risk-adaptive feature workflow ported from ZCode: explore, architect, bounded implementation, evidence verification and independent review as five skills.
description.zh: 从 ZCode 移植的功能开发工作流：探索、架构、有边界实现、证据验证与独立审查，五个技能可由 subagent 分角色执行。

description.en: Ghidra + GhidraMCP setup, headless analysis and DSH MCP wiring.
description.zh: Ghidra + GhidraMCP 安装、无头批量分析与 DSH MCP 接线。

description.en: Image generation and editing on the local ChatGPT/Codex OAuth login: imgen skill plus the imgen MCP server (imgen_generate / imgen_health), no API key, no per-image billing.
description.zh: 用本机已登录的 ChatGPT / Codex 账号（OAuth）生图与改图：imgen 技能 + imgen MCP（imgen_generate / imgen_health），不要 API Key，不按张计费。

description.en: Codex computer use decoupled from the app: a relay that puts the official ChatGPT/Codex CUA runtime (LCU) behind DSH MCP, with js / js_reset and a Touch ID approval policy.
description.zh: 把 Codex 官方 computer-use 运行时（LCU）接成 DSH 的 MCP：js / js_reset 两个工具，App 控制按 Touch ID 批准名单放行，未批准一律 decline。

description.en: Jianying/CapCut editing through the existing Python MCP engine: 61 jy_* tools for project transactions, subtitles, member TTS, official ASR/music, local media jobs and QC, plus the jianying-edit DSH skill. Private repository: installation requires GitHub access to the repository.
description.zh: 把已有剪映 Python MCP 引擎接进 DSH：61 个 jy_* 工具，覆盖工程事务、字幕、会员配音、官方 ASR 与音乐、本地媒体任务与质检，附 jianying-edit 技能。仓库为私有，安装需要本机对该 GitHub 仓库有访问权限。

description.en: Per-project memory isolated by absolute-path hash under .dsh/memory/<slug>.md, with a project-memory skill and memory_write/memory_read/memory_status tools.
description.zh: 按项目绝对路径哈希隔离的 .dsh/memory/<slug>.md 记忆，配 project-memory 技能与三个记忆工具。

description.en: REA skill plus the official rea-agents MCP server for native, managed, Electron and firmware artifacts.
description.zh: REA 配套 Skill + 官方 rea-agents MCP，覆盖原生、托管、Electron 与固件目标。

description.en: 46 reverse-engineering, exploitation, CTF, mobile and firmware skills with the upstream routing core.
description.zh: 46 个逆向/破解/渗透/CTF/移动/固件技能，含上游路由核心与 scope 门禁。

title.zh: 自动记忆（每工作区一份 MEMORY.md）

description.en: Ambient-recall workspace memory: one MEMORY.md per workspace under .dsh/memory with a global layer, auto recall across sessions and windows, plus a full settings panel (recall, tour, skins). Keyword/BM25 retrieval works out of the box; semantic retrieval is an optional Python engine.
description.zh: 跨会话自动记忆：每个工作区一份 <cwd>/.dsh/memory/MEMORY.md + 全局层，自动召回跨会话生效；带完整设置面板（回顾、引导、皮肤）。关键词/BM25 检索开箱即用，语义检索是可选 Python 引擎。

description.en: brking.ai product catalog for DSH: 13 product_* MCP tools (search, images, compare, audit, context, cache, sync) plus the product-library skill. Metadata and image URLs only; ready as reference images for e-commerce main images, detail pages and Xiaohongshu posts.
description.zh: brking.ai 产品库 DSH 插件：13 个 product_* MCP 工具（搜索、取图、对比、图片审计、做图上下文、按需缓存、同步）+ product-library 技能；只存元数据与图床 URL，可直接给主图/详情页/小红书做图提供参考图。

title.zh: 浏览器（无头 Chrome / 扩展）dsh-browser

description.en: Native DSH browser plugin: 11 browser_* MCP tools over the Chrome DevTools Protocol, zero npm dependencies. Headless Chrome, a visible Chrome profile with unpacked extensions, or attach to an existing CDP endpoint; includes the browser-automation skill.
description.zh: DSH 原生浏览器插件：11 个 browser_* MCP 工具，零 npm 依赖，直连 Chrome DevTools Protocol；支持无头 Chrome、可见 Chrome（可加载 unpacked 扩展、复用持久 profile）与 attach 已有调试端口；含 browser-automation 技能。

description.en: Playwright-core browser plugin for DSH: 12 browser_* MCP tools (headless / headed / attach, screenshot, PDF, wait, tabs). Only dependency is playwright-core; launches the system Google Chrome, no bundled Chromium download.
description.zh: DSH 的 Playwright 内核浏览器插件：12 个 browser_* MCP 工具（无头 / 有头 / attach、截图、PDF、等待、标签页）。唯一依赖 playwright-core，默认调用系统 Google Chrome，不下载 Chromium。
